summary: 1 short video covering all 7 verses (reciter Yasser ad-Dussary): the surah is 45 s of recitation and one unit of meaning
made_by: Research 2026-11-21 (cloud agent): audit_surah.py with reciter 97, Saheeh translation, Al-Muyassar and As-Sa'di read verse by verse.
notes: Text: all 7 verses identical to Tanzil Uthmani. Verse 1 is the basmala (Hafs numbering).
Timing: complete for every word, no short-word flags, no repetitions.
Boundaries: 1-5 end in real pauses; Dussary joins verse 6 to verse 7 without a pause (JOINED). The video covers 1-7 whole, so nothing is cut there; the highlight follows the timing data at 6->7.
Pictures: ambient only (names and attributes of Allah, worship, du'a). The Day of Recompense (4) gets only an hourglass symbol, never a scene.
Explanations: the two groups in verse 7 are explained by their description from As-Sa'di (knew the truth and left it / left it out of ignorance), without naming them; both tafsirs agree.

groups.intro: The whole surah in one video.

videos.title_en: The greatest surah of the Quran
videos.care: Ambient only; no figure; the Day of Recompense as a symbol only.
